Mean-field dynamical system ensemble Kalman inversion (MFDS)

Source: R/mfds.R
MFDS.Rd

The derivative-free method of Huang, Huang, Reich and Stuart (2022, "Efficient derivative-free Bayesian inference for large-scale inverse problems"). The posterior is the fixed point of a filtering problem: at each iteration the ensemble is inflated about its mean (the prediction) and then updated by an ensemble Kalman step with the augmented observation (the data and the prior mean, observed through the simulated data and the parameters), with the noise of both scaled by 1/delta_t. For linear-Gaussian problems the ensemble's mean and covariance converge to the posterior's.

Usage

MFDS(
  recipe,
  results_name,
  results_path = getwd(),
  number_of_ensemble_members,
  number_of_iterations,
  delta_t = 0.5,
  iterations_to_store = 2,
  model_parameter_list = list(),
  external_packages = c(),
  julia_bin_dir = "",
  julia_required_libraries = c(),
  verify_cpp_function_types = FALSE,
  keep_temporary_recipe_code = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  algorithm = NULL
)

Arguments

recipe

A recipe from compile, or the file name(s) of an ilike file.

results_name

The name of the folder for the results (in results_path).

results_path

(optional) The folder in which results_name is made.

number_of_ensemble_members

The number of ensemble members.

number_of_iterations

The number of iterations.

delta_t

(optional) The step, between 0 and 1 (default 0.5, as in the paper).

iterations_to_store

(optional) The number of iterations kept in memory while running (at least 2).

model_parameter_list

(optional) A list of run-time constants for the recipe.

external_packages

(optional) Packages used by R functions in the recipe.

julia_bin_dir

(optional) The folder of the Julia executable.

julia_required_libraries

(optional) Julia packages used by the recipe.

verify_cpp_function_types

(optional) Check the types of C++ functions in the recipe.

keep_temporary_recipe_code

(optional) Keep the generated C++ code.

seed

(optional) The seed of the random number generator.

algorithm

(optional) For a recipe in the ilike language: the name of the algorithm section to run (needed when the recipe has several).

Value

Invisibly, the folder holding the results.

Details

The model needs a Gaussian prior on every parameter, given by built-in prior blocks (prior,ilike::norm or prior,ilike::mvnorm), and the likelihood as a simulator: a simulate_data_model block (which includes the observation noise), a data_variable block and optionally a summary_statistics block. An enk_shifter block chooses the update: ilike::stochastic (perturbed observations, the default) or ilike::adjustment (ensemble adjustment). There is no estimate of the evidence; read the ensembles with load_enk_output (one target per iteration).
